title: Joining a campus photography club
objectives: Explain your experience and ask if beginners can join
Ask what happens at a meeting

courseTemplate.setting: Phone photography is welcome. The club offers photo walks and editing workshops. A sign-up form is at the desk.

roles.learner: A student interested in joining a club
roles.partner: A photography club volunteer at a fair

courseTemplate.openingLine: Hi! Are you interested in joining the photography club?

stages.title: Explain your experience and ask if beginners can join
stages.instruction: Use the course facts to invite this task. A natural prompt is “Hi! Are you interested in joining the photography club?”
successCriteria: The learner can explain your experience and ask if beginners can join in their own words.
hints: You can start with “Yes, but I only …”

stages.title: Ask what happens at a meeting
stages.instruction: Use the course facts to invite this task. A natural prompt is “Absolutely. A phone is all you need. What else would you like to know?”
successCriteria: The learner can ask what happens at a meeting in their own words.
hints: You can start with “What do you usually …”

stages.title: Ask how to sign up
stages.instruction: Use the course facts to invite this task. A natural prompt is “We do photo walks and editing workshops. The next one is on Tuesday.”
successCriteria: The learner can ask how to sign up in their own words.
hints: You can start with “That sounds fun. Where …”
